GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Not Bustled but Straight To The Front Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear own terms, trav well To The Turn Collared Straightening Up and Soon After gone! - # vet found nothing
Jumped Fast Straight To The Front Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear own terms ! Joined x 600m Under Pressure Soon After Straightening Up dueling to the shadows, had its chance - # had all favours
Jumped okay & Went Forward to 1.5 Lengths Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led 1 length turning, kept going in Straight # led all the way

Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd on fence trailing 1.5 Lengths , Moved Up to 1 length Two Wide turning, kept chasing the leader/winner all the way down the straight. Narrowed the margin but could never take the winner. # winner too tough

Slow out then kicked up & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths on fence, tightened 1700m, shuffled back middle stages, Hooked Out to 2 Lengths Four Wide turning, Five Wide Straightening Up and kept coming in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly middle stages.] # Wide from the turn
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 1700m, raced in restricted room and steadied. Raced keenly in the middle stages. Laid in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Wide trailing a half length, Drifted Back to 4.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, couldn't come on in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages.] # always Wide
Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths 3 Wide , little change to 3 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages.] # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keen early. Raced wide without cover from the 1100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 5 Lengths turning, compounded badly in straight. [Stewards: Rider reported it put in an awkward stride at 600m and, although he then pressured it, it failed to respond to his riding and he elected to ease it down from 400m. Post-race vet exam revealed harsh bilateral lung sounds which could be attributed to a degree of exercise induced pulmonary hemorrhaging. Developed a swollen eye on return to stables. Eye returned to normal after treatment. Vet clearance required.] # eased down at 400m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Jky Stanley reported the gelding put in an awkward stride near the 600m & although he then placed his mount under some more pressure, failed to respond to his riding & as a result he elected to ease the gelding down from the 400m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 5 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to 3.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, shifetd out to centre of track Straightening Up and ran on solidly in straight, dived on the line but arrived a bit too late. (Blinkers AGAIN, Winkers OFF FIRST TIME) # just missed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Had difficulty obtaining clear running near the 500m for a short distance.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 4 Lengths on fence, little change to 3.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, held onto 4th place while losing ground in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages.] # no excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early stages. Near the 1500m had to ease when in restricted room to the inside of POWER PACK which had shifted in and away from the heels of PINK VIXEN which had shifted in when not quite clear.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Stumbled on jumping & Settled Down 4 Lengths Four Wide , little change to 5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, shifted 4-5 Wide Straightening Up then steered out to a lane past centre of track, kept coming in straight. (Blinkers OFF FIRST TIME, Winkers FIRST TIME) # wide, kept coming

Jumped okay & Settled Down Four Wide trailing a half length, pressed on and went clear crossing at the 950m, Held Together in front & led by a half head turning, kept kicking in straight, Headed narrowly at 150m but kept battling to line # worked early/ok run
